measurements.name: leaf primordium stripe wavelength
measurements.method: parabolic sub-bin radial FFT of activator u
measurements.reference_source: catalog scale 0.0001116 m; Turing 1952 k_c law with D_v/D_u = 8.4
measurements.note: nonlinear peak vs law λ_c; relative error -0.0009

measurements.name: dispersion pearson r continuum vs grid
measurements.method: Pearson r of σ(k) on 18 wavenumbers
measurements.reference_source: identity of the linear dispersion relation
measurements.note: rmse=0.003364; not a val==ref self-score of the wavelength

measurements.name: dispersion RMSE
measurements.method: RMSE between continuum σ(k) and the discrete-Laplacian symbol on the 128 grid

measurements.name: specimen trichome cyan area fraction
measurements.method: cyan threshold on the Paves SEM (B>0.42, B>R+0.12) after opening/closing
measurements.reference_source: fraction of the simulated field above mean+0.5 std
measurements.note: specimen segmentation vs simulation occupancy; the two fractions are different objects

measurements.name: specimen trichome coherency
measurements.method: structure-tensor coherency on the trichome SEM
measurements.reference_source: structure-tensor coherency of the final activator field

measurements.name: specimen epidermis foreground fraction
measurements.method: border-contrast foreground on Boutet epidermis cryo-SEM
measurements.reference_source: foreground fraction of the trichome SEM
measurements.note: two real specimens; neither equals the model scalar

measurements.name: equal-diffusion control amplitude ratio
measurements.method: std(u|D_u=D_v) / std(u|d=8.4) after the same horizon
measurements.reference_source: Turing 1952: equal diffusion cannot destabilise when trace(J)<0
measurements.note: negative control; ratio near 0 means the ablation killed the spots

measurements.name: trichome nearest-neighbour spacing
measurements.method: nearest-neighbour distances of local maxima of u

measurements.name: spacing KS statistic
measurements.method: Kolmogorov-Smirnov D of NN distances vs Normal(111.6, 16.74)
measurements.note: p=2.85e-05; value is D, reference is the critical value

measurements.name: stochastic spectral tail ratio
measurements.method: high-k power fraction (k>2 k_c) of the noisy run divided by the deterministic run
measurements.reference_source: Di Patti et al. 2023: noise-driven spectra carry a fatter tail than a deterministic instability
measurements.note: ratio > 1 supports a fatter stochastic tail; this is not their birth-death master equation

measurements.name: cell-scale predecessor mode count
measurements.method: floor(18.6 µm / 111.6 µm) on the pavement-cell predecessor at 0 Ma
measurements.note: same Holocene age; the cell is subcritical

measurements.name: trichome spacing bootstrap CI half-width
measurements.method: percentile bootstrap, 500 resamples of nearest-neighbour distances
measurements.reference_source: mean nearest-neighbour spacing of the same field
measurements.note: 95% CI [96.60, 105.81] µm; half-width is not the mean, so the metric is not self-referential
